mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiries ( user_id, title, content, response_status, response ) VALUES ( #{user_id}, #{title}, #{content}, "pending", "" );
mapper.select: SELECT inquiry_id, user_id, title, content, response_status, response, created_at FROM inquiries WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY created_at DESC;
mapper.update: UPDATE theme SET theme_name = #{theme_name}, theme_info = #{theme_info}, logoURL = #{logoURL} WHERE theme_id = 1
UPDATE banner SET banner_title = #{banner_title}, banner_imageURL = #{banner_imageURL} WHERE banner_id = 1
